issues.fix: Check who trades at 943 Route 33 W now; if Hardware Garden 33 is operating, add it and soften the categories_thin note. If it is the same building as Burroughs, note it as a duplicate to avoid a cold-call clash.

issues.claim: The Social & Co. - Monroe (1 Rossmoor Dr, Bldg 2) filed as an 'independent specialty retailer'
issues.problem: thesocialandco.com lists the Monroe store alongside Jersey City / Woodbridge / Rahway locations - a small multi-store New Jersey operator, not clearly independent - and the product line is hemp/THC/CBD plus tobacco. The chain exclusion was applied to national franchisors only, so this is a judgement call, not a proven violation.
issues.fix: Confirm the client's chain threshold; if multi-location retail counts as a chain, drop it. Its own site's core products (hemp-derived) should also be checked against the exclusion list.

issues.claim: Ellie's Academy of Monroe filed as an in-scope private preschool/child care
issues.problem: elliesacademy.com runs a /locations/ structure (a multi-site New Jersey preschool group) and the site is a licensed child-care centre covered by the NJ DCF centre list - similar in kind to the Kiddie Academy / Goddard / Childtime chains the mapper excluded. The rationale is documented but inconsistent.
issues.fix: Apply one rule to all preschools: either keep all private child-care centres or drop all multi-site brands.
